python3 - << 'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('lib/widgets/void_settings_sheet.dart')
text = p.read_text()
start_ix = text.find("          CassetteScreenConfig() => [")
print('start_ix', start_ix)
if start_ix != -1:
    # We'll find the end of this CassetteScreenConfig block by locating the next line containing '],' that ends the array? But easier: find the next occurrence of "]," followed by a newline and two spaces (the indentation for the next item). We'll search for '\n            ],' pattern.
    end_marker = '\n            ],'  # with 12 spaces? We'll search for pattern
    end_ix = text.find(end_marker, start_ix)
    print('end_ix', end_ix)
    if end_ix != -1:
        before = text[:start_ix]
        after = text[end_ix+len(end_marker):]
        new_block = """          CassetteScreenConfig() => [
              textSize('void-settings-cassette-text-size', cfg.textScale,
                  (v) => cfg.copyWith(textScale: v)),
              _Toggle(
                'void-settings-cassette-haptics',
                'haptics',
                cfg.hapticsEnabled,
                () => settings.saveScreenConfig(cfg.copyWith(hapticsEnabled: !cfg.hapticsEnabled)),
              ),
            ],"""
        new_text = before + new_block + after
        p.write_text(new_text)
        print('Block replaced')
    else:
        print('End marker not found')
else:
    print('Start not found')
PY
